findings.title: Production new-game barrier still freezes classic context before actual campaign classification
findings.evidence: The real R9 Battle entry calls configure(self, _run_clock), so the fixed barrier default third argument selects CLASSIC_CONTEXT (defense/empty level/30 waves). The actual Battle context is classified only later, and there is no subsequent configure/context write. The new readonly equality to DAMING_CONTEXT therefore fails deterministically; barrier._scope also rejects the official campaign in the classic branch. The old extra harness configure was removed, exposing this production entry gap.
findings.required_successor_change: In a new immutable production candidate entry, bind the barrier to the actual trusted classification once the real level/context exists, before capture can be requested. Keep the readonly ownership/context assertion. Do not reintroduce harness reconfiguration, forge context, or weaken classic/campaign capture scope checks.
